scope: all 10 decisions in the offset-2 manual canary and no others

reviews.title: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)
reviews.reviewReason: The monk asks for 峭峻之機 and the master places 十字街頭 inside his answer, 十字街頭八字立. The crossroads is therefore the answer-image that performs the case, not a location in its narrative frame.

reviews.title: 指月錄
reviews.reviewReason: In 祖師面壁意作麼生, the actual topic is 祖師面壁; 意作麼生 merely asks what that preceding topic means. Because the antecedent can be replaced while this interrogative frame remains, the exact string does not name a stable saying-level Chan unit. The rejection is specifically confirmed.

reviews.title: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)
reviews.reviewReason: Before anyone crosses the hall door, the speaker pronounces that their heels 好與三十棒. The phrase is a complete prospective sanction in the address and supplies its Chan verdict, rather than reporting a beating that occurred.

reviews.title: 古尊宿語錄
reviews.reviewReason: 超佛越祖之談 is expressly requested, after which the raised staff becomes the test of whether the monk can identify such speech. The phrase names the category governing the exchange and is not incidental praise.

reviews.title: 五燈會元
reviews.reviewReason: After explaining non-obstruction of事 and 理, the teacher makes 隨時著衣喫飯 the concrete way to continue, nourish the sacred embryo, and pass the time freely. The paired daily acts are deliberately deployed as practice in ordinary activity.

reviews.title: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)
reviews.reviewReason: The teacher quotes all three coordinated denials before judging the old formulation as a partial glimpse. The object of quotation and criticism is the whole three-clause formula. Under this project's unit vocabulary, `couplet` is the correct indivisible multi-clause classification even though it contains three members.

reviews.title: 宗門拈古彙集
reviews.reviewReason: 天寧琦 applies 個個龍頭蛇尾 to later descendants as his diagnosis of performances whose imposing beginning collapses at the end. The animals form a figurative evaluative compound, not literal zoological description.

reviews.title: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)
reviews.reviewReason: The monk explicitly asks for 截斷眾流句 between the 函蓋乾坤 and 隨波逐浪 sentence-functions; the master answers 鐵山橫在路. The phrase labels a distinguished Chan sentence-function and organizes the three-question sequence.

reviews.title: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)
reviews.reviewReason: The address makes the paired animals the knowing side of a pointed contrast with 三世諸佛 and then unfolds that knowing as 明大用、曉全機. 狸奴白牯 carries the inherited Nanquan case-image, not a livestock reference.

reviews.title: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)
reviews.reviewReason: The same consequence closes both alternatives—taking the awakening as a blow and not taking it as a blow. Its doubled, symmetrical use makes 入地獄如箭射 the teacher's categorical verdict against either conceptual reading.

methodAssessment: The source ledger's reasons track ten different textual operations: answer-image, replaceable interrogative frame, sanction, named utterance category, ordinary-activity practice, quoted triple denial, case diagnosis, sentence-function, inherited animal contrast, and doubled consequence. Their sentence structures and evidence dependencies are materially distinct. No repeated semantic slot, count threshold, regex cue, or default disposition is visible; the one rejection is justified by syntactic containment rather than low frequency.
